disclaimer: This is not live monitoring. Data only arrives after the watch has synced to the phone and the phone is online, so it can be anywhere from a few minutes to several hours late. JoyoFit is not an emergency tool and does not detect falls, heart attacks, or other serious conditions. If you are worried, call them directly or contact emergency services (112).

consent.title: Let {{name}} see how you are doing?
consent.intro: {{name}} wants to keep an eye on how you are doing through your Huawei watch. You decide what is shared.
consent.neverShared: Never shared: location, workout routes, minute-by-minute heart rate, food, photos.
consent.alerts: {{name}} may get an alert when your data looks unusual, for example no steps by midday. That is not a medical diagnosis.
consent.revoke: You can pause or stop at any time. If you stop, {{name}} can no longer see anything and the history is deleted.
consent.handled: You have already set this permission. Its settings are on the Watched screen.
consent.notFound: This request was not found. It may have been cancelled.

platform.android: On Android, JoyoFit sends data in the background every time the watch finishes syncing to the phone, even when JoyoFit is closed. If the phone is offline, the data follows once it reconnects.
platform.ios: On iPhone, iOS decides when JoyoFit may send in the background. Data often only goes out when you open JoyoFit or when the watch wakes it up, so updates can be late.
